title: How a generation request flows

nodes.label: React web app
nodes.note: Vite single-page app. Idea input, live agent progress (services/streaming.ts), clarifying questions, review step and history, with Zustand stores.

nodes.label: Rate limit middleware
nodes.note: api/middleware/rate_limit.py: 30 requests per minute per caller using an in-memory sliding window, plus CORS in api/main.py.

nodes.label: Auth routes
nodes.note: routes/auth.py: register, login, refresh, email verification, Google sign-in. bcrypt password hashes, JWT access tokens, usage endpoint.

nodes.label: Streaming routes
nodes.note: routes/streaming.py: /generate/stream and /answers/stream. Checks the daily post limit, loads the brand profile, starts the run, returns an SSE response.

nodes.label: Brand profile routes
nodes.note: routes/brand_profile.py: voice, audience, content pillars and sample posts, which every agent receives as context.

nodes.label: History service
nodes.note: services/history.py: creates a history row per post, saves every agent event and each phase's output for the history and analytics pages.

nodes.label: Email service
nodes.note: services/email.py: sends verification emails with smtplib, run in a threadpool so the event loop is not blocked.

nodes.label: LangGraph pipeline
nodes.note: orchestration/graph.py: nodes, conditional routing and the revision loop over a typed AgentState. Runs as an asyncio task in the API process.

nodes.label: Validator agent
nodes.note: Judges the raw idea against the brand profile and returns APPROVE, REFINE or REJECT. Only REJECT ends the run, with suggestions.

nodes.label: Strategist agent
nodes.note: Picks the post format and writes clarifying questions. The graph stops here until the user answers.

nodes.label: Writer agent
nodes.note: Produces scored hooks, the body, a call to action and hashtags from the idea, strategy and the user's answers.

nodes.label: Visual designer agent
nodes.note: Runs only for carousel posts. Turns the draft into slide-by-slide visual specs.

nodes.label: Optimizer agent
nodes.note: Scores the draft and predicts an impressions range. Returns APPROVE or REVISE, and REVISE loops back to the writer at most twice.

nodes.label: Execution tracker
nodes.note: orchestration/callbacks.py: emits agent_start, agent_complete and status_update events with progress percentages to registered callbacks.

nodes.label: SSE event queue
nodes.note: One in-process asyncio.Queue per generation. The SSE response reads it and sends a keepalive ping after 60 seconds of silence.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.note: Async SQLAlchemy models: users, brand profiles, posts, agent executions, generation history and events. Alembic migrations.

nodes.label: Gemini API
nodes.note: llm/gemini.py: GeminiClient used by every agent, with structured JSON output, token counting and a cost estimate.

nodes.label: Google sign-in
nodes.note: Google OAuth. The backend verifies the ID token with google-auth and creates or finds the user.

nodes.label: Brevo SMTP
nodes.note: Transactional email relay that delivers the verification message.

flow: The browser POSTs an idea to /generate/stream with a JWT. The rate-limit middleware passes it and the route checks the user's daily post limit in PostgreSQL.
The route loads the user's brand profile, starts the first phase as an asyncio task, and returns an SSE response tied to a fresh event queue.
The validator runs on Gemini. A rejection ends the run with suggestions; otherwise the strategist picks a format and writes clarifying questions.
Each agent start and finish passes through the execution tracker into the queue and is saved by the history service, so the UI shows progress live.
The graph pauses. The user answers, and /answers/stream starts the second phase.
The writer drafts, the visual designer runs only for carousels, and the optimizer scores the draft. A REVISE sends it back to the writer, at most twice.
The final post, with hooks, hashtags and a quality score, streams back and is stored in PostgreSQL.
Secondary path: on sign-up, the email service sends a verification link through Brevo SMTP in a threadpool.
